name: @bounded-sh/observe-mcp
stderr:
bounded observe mcp: missing --token / BOUNDED_SENSOR_TOKEN

bounded observe mcp — wrap an MCP server and observe every tool call.

  Local stdio server (primary, T9-clean):
    bounded observe mcp [flags] -- <server-command...>
  Remote streamable-HTTP endpoint (secondary):
    bounded observe mcp --http --upstream <url> [flags]

Config (flags or env):
  --token / BOUNDED_SENSOR_TOKEN   obs1.<keyId>.<sig> sensor key (required). The key IS the actor.
  --org   / BOUNDED_ORG            org slug (for logs/self-filter; ingest stamps authoritatively)
  --actor / BOUNDED_ACTOR          actor id override (default mcp:<keyId>); kind=agent, grade=attested
  --name  / BOUNDED_MCP_SERVER_NAME  server name override (else serverInfo.name / basename)
  --ingest/ BOUNDED_INGEST_BASE    ingest base URL (default prod)
  --capture <field> (repeatable) / BOUNDED_CAPTURE_FIELDS=a,b  extra manifest-allowed arg values
  --on-behalf-of / BOUNDED_ON_BEHALF_OF  default opaque end-customer id
  --upstream / BOUNDED_MCP_UPSTREAM  remote MCP url (http mode)
  --port  / BOUNDED_MCP_PORT        local listen port for http mode (default ephemeral)
  --debug / BOUNDED_DEBUG          verbose stderr logging
